targetTasks.summary: Current window: AlembicCore. Claim only task rg2-core-dimension-planning-dynamic-signals-t1 under stateRoot .wakeflow-active/current/alembic-recipe-evolution-optimization-2026-06-21. Context: RG-1 is accepted at AlembicCore commit b1a9f074018c7e248dbd439f1a501fc496a9ac79 and added architectureIntelligence capabilities through project-context/project-context-capabilities. Goal: implement RG-2 Core B-stage capabilities as real deterministic Core code, additive and package-boundary clean, so later RG-3 Plan draft can depend on truthful project signals rather than language-only guesses. Required behavior: (1) refactor or add a signal-aware dimension selection path using RG-1 DomainSignal/ArchitectureStyle/Complexity/ProjectInformationSupplement outputs; preserve existing resolveActiveDimensions public behavior unless introducing an additive overload or adjacent API, and prove language/framework alone is not enough to select domain dimensions; (2) provide deterministic planning aids for future Plan draft: recommended dimensions with evidence/reasons, dimension ordering, suggested ProjectContext/MCP information-gathering steps, project scale/budget classification, subset/scoping hints, cross-dimension constraints, and explicit unavailable/low-confidence signals; this is Core data, not an agent prompt or DB plan; (3) add a DynamicSignalGateway or equivalent Core facade that aggregates available real signals from project context, shared graph/code_entities/knowledge_edges-shaped data, coverage/recipe gaps, new-module/hotspot information, and proposal/decay-like inputs where existing Core repositories expose them; keep it bounded and deterministic, no daemon or watcher; (4) add ModuleDeltaDetector and per-module coverage query/support needed by later Plan/evolution, including deterministic handling of new/changed/removed modules and rename candidates if implemented, with default rename similarity threshold 0.90 when rename scoring is present; do not implement commit-driven evolution or rescan orchestration here; (5) expose only the minimum Core surfaces needed for downstream Plugin consumption, following AlembicCore package/export boundary rules; (6) add fixture-backed tests showing BiliDili-like Swift/SwiftUI/network/concurrency/testing signals are selected from imports/symbols/config/graph evidence, while a same-language project without those signals does not get them, plus tests for planning aids, dynamic signal aggregation, ModuleDelta/per-module coverage, and compatibility with existing dimension/project-intelligence behavior. Boundaries: do not implement RG-3 plans table/alembic_plan/draft-confirm-get, do not implement Plugin wiring, three-stage Recipe generation, create-time ProjectContext anchor, vector isolation, commit-driven unified evolution, Test/BiliDili run, daemon-removal changes, four-tool MCP semantics changes, or deletion of evidence/proposals/vector structures. Do not return a type-only shell, empty interface, static mock, or language-only heuristic rename. If this full RG-2 slice is too large for one target turn, return blocked/needs-review with the smallest executable split and raw evidence; otherwise complete with commit hash, changed files, evidence refs, validation output, risks, and next-step notes. Expected validation: npm run build:check; targeted tests for new signal-aware dimension selection/planning aids/dynamic signal gateway/module delta/per-module coverage; existing dimension registry and project-intelligence/ProjectContext tests touched by the change; public API/export/boundary tests if exports change; npm run lint or npm run check when feasible; git diff --check.
